Descs: ['A manifestation of "emotion," the collective conviction within humanity\'s subconscious.\\n[Mercy] is not bound by the attachment of "self," viewing all suffering as a speck of dust in the vast world, and thus fears no harm.\\nIt permits all that transpires, and therefore can accept all things.\\nThis is precisely why it can heal the deep pain within a Construct\'s M.I.N.D.: when all life is linked by an invisible emotional bond, our joy and sorrow transform into dust traveling together in the light, ceaselessly seeking the possibilities of the future within each other\'s reflection.']
AsideTips: Emotion draws its strength from a deep faith in life itself. When the will of all beings resonates as one, the tide that rises from it becomes the Sefirah of Mercy.

Descs: ['An answer Dominik decoded from cosmic information, a civilization blueprint named "Crown".\\nThe moment the chosen one dons the crown, they will observe all possible branches of the entire universe. Its power can intervene in local gravitational fields to achieve spatial folding, enabling civilization to traverse any distance and lock onto a single future at the branching point of time.\\nBut the [Crown] is heavy—its weight comes from bearing the full weight of every possibility the world holds.\\nChoosing the path toward the "one and only" for civilization also means forever carrying all other possibilities that were "forsaken."', 'In defiance of fate, the crowned one breaks free from time\'s shackles and shoulders the weight of every consequence her choices beget.\\n[Atheism] refuses to accept the universe\'s binary law of "pruning" and "preservation." It absorbs the information flowing out of the Fog and draws it into the M.I.N.D. of the Sefirah bearer, winning the world a chance to pass through the "Gateway" once more and reach the future.\\nIf "choice" must always be accompanied by pain, then the remaining suffering and despair shall be borne by the crowned one alone; while the happiness and "rightness" of what was chosen shall be returned to this world by their own hands.\\nWithout need for anyone\'s approval, [Atheism] will exist regardless. As long as the conviction of "wishing someone happiness" continues to burn, there will always be one who keeps eternal vigil upon this solitary throne.']

['The primal impulse rooted in all higher beings: the drive to seek "cognition."\\n[Understanding] sees through appearances and lays bare the information beneath. All things may be reshaped, rewritten, and even woven together into entirely new forms.\\nYet every mind has its limits. No one can remake what they cannot accept. The act of understanding is never free from the perspective of the one who perceives. Therefore, the bearer must undergo the process of coming to know others, coming to know the world, and ultimately achieving complete insight into the self. Only by fully knowing oneself can [Understanding] truly be mastered.\\nAnd so the gaze of life reaches not only beyond the stars, but also upon its unquestioned self.']
